events.title: Suleiman the Magnificent crushes Hungary at Mohács
events.description: The Ottoman army destroyed the Hungarian forces at Mohács; King Louis II drowned while fleeing. Hungary was partitioned, and the Habsburgs inherited its crown.
events.html: The Ottoman army destroyed the Hungarian forces at Mohács; King Louis II drowned while fleeing. Hungary was partitioned, and the Habsburgs inherited its crown.

events.title: The Treaty of Nanking ends the First Opium War
events.description: China ceded Hong Kong Island to Britain, opened five ports to foreign trade and paid a large indemnity. It was the first of the 'unequal treaties' China remembers as a century of humiliation.
events.html: China ceded Hong Kong Island to Britain, opened five ports to foreign trade and paid a large indemnity. It was the first of the 'unequal treaties' China remembers as a century of humiliation.

events.title: The Soviet Union tests its first atomic bomb
events.description: The USSR exploded its first atomic bomb at Semipalatinsk in Kazakhstan, years earlier than the West expected. The American nuclear monopoly was over and the arms race had begun.
events.html: The USSR exploded its first atomic bomb at Semipalatinsk in Kazakhstan, years earlier than the West expected. The American nuclear monopoly was over and the arms race had begun.

events.title: The Beatles play their last concert for paying fans
events.description: The Beatles played a half-hour set at Candlestick Park in San Francisco. They then gave up touring to concentrate on studio albums such as Sgt. Pepper's Lonely Hearts Club Band.
events.html: The Beatles played a half-hour set at Candlestick Park in San Francisco. They then gave up touring to concentrate on studio albums such as Sgt. Pepper's Lonely Hearts Club Band.

events.title: Hurricane Katrina strikes the US Gulf Coast
events.description: Katrina made landfall as a Category 3 hurricane; storm surge broke the levees of New Orleans and flooded some 80 per cent of the city. More than 1,300 people died and the government response was widely condemned.
